fullContentHtml:
UP Police Constable PET Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board (UPPRPB) has Released the PET Admit Card for the UP Police Constable post. This recruitment was released for 32,679 posts. Applications for the UP Police Constable Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 31 December 2025 to 30 January 2026. The PET is going to conducted on 08 October 2026. Candidates must download their UP Police Constable PET Schedule 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 31 December 2025
  • Application Start Date : 31 December 2025
  • Last Date : 30 January 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 30 January 2026
  • Date of Adjustment of Deposited Fee : 02 February 2026
  • Correction Date : 31 January 2026 to 03 February 2026
  • Exam Date : 08, 09 & 10 June 2026
  • Admit Card : 04 June 2026
  • Answer Key Available : 20 June 2026
  • Result / Final Answer Key Available : 31 July 2026
  • DV / PST Start : 17 August 2026
  • DV / PST Admit Card : 10 August 2026
  • PET Date : 08 October 2026
  • PET Admit Card : 24 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 400/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

UP Police Constable PET Admit Card 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.
